Trace, implement and test: Palindrome Numbers In Range

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
package Problems_On_Number;

public class PalindromeNumbersInRange {
    static boolean isPalindrome(int n) {

        int reverse = 0;
        int temp = n;
        while (temp > 0) {
            reverse = reverse * 10 + temp % 10;
            temp = temp / 10;
        }

        // If n and reverse are same,
        // then n is palindrome
        if (n == reverse)
            return true;
        return false;
    }

    public static void main(String args[]) {
        int min = 100;
        int max = 150;
        for (int i = min; i <= max; i++) {
            if (isPalindrome(i)) {
                System.out.print(i + " ");
            }
        }

    }

}
